Now write SQL: join pitStops with drivers, filter nationality='German', dob between 1980-01-01 and 1985-12-31, group by driver, avg(milliseconds), order asc, limit 3.

Consensus qid=5 says "between 1980 and 1985" are year ranges, "born before 1985" compares birth year. So dob year between 1980 and 1985 inclusive.

Let me write the SQL.
Now let me execute the query joining pit stops with drivers.

input.sql: SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, d.nationality, d.dob, AVG(p.milliseconds) AS avg_pit_stop_ms FROM pitStops p JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985 GROUP BY d.driverId ORDER BY avg_pit_stop_ms ASC LIMIT 3;
